about.title: About Mortgage Payoff Calculator - Early Payment Planning Tool
about.description: The Mortgage Payoff Calculator is a comprehensive mortgage acceleration tool designed to help homeowners calculate the benefits of making extra principal payments to pay off their mortgage early. This calculator shows how additional payments can save thousands in interest costs and reduce loan terms by years. Whether you're considering bi-weekly payments, annual lump sums, or monthly extra payments, this tool provides accurate projections for mortgage payoff strategies.

faq.q: How much can I save by paying extra on my mortgage?
faq.a: Extra payments can save substantial interest. For example, paying an extra $100/month on a $300,000, 30-year mortgage at 6% can save over $60,000 in interest and reduce the loan term by 6 years.

faq.q: Should I pay extra on my mortgage or invest the money?
faq.a: This depends on your mortgage rate vs potential investment returns. If you can earn more investing than your mortgage rate (after taxes), investing may be better. However, mortgage payoff provides guaranteed savings and peace of mind.

faq.q: What's the best extra payment strategy?
faq.a: Bi-weekly payments are effective and automatic, while extra monthly principal payments offer flexibility. The best strategy depends on your cash flow, discipline, and financial goals.

faq.q: When should I avoid paying extra on my mortgage?
faq.a: Avoid extra payments if you have high-interest debt, lack emergency savings, or can earn significantly higher returns through investments. Also consider if you plan to move soon or need liquidity.
